reviews.title: 1-hr watching as many ads as possible
reviews.text:
Best conversion of gems to cash after a 3-hr timer. This app has a better conversion rate than best play and any of the other apps, but you literally have to sit there and just watch ads for an hour straight to earn $2. 

Definitely not going to replace a day job, but it could absolutely buy you a coffee or drink of choice once a week if you watch enough ads for an hour a day all week long. $2/day is $14/week

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text:
I was really hopeful when I read all the great reviews and like no bad ones. 

I get into the app and see a thing floating on my screen. Watch a video and smash the piggy. Watched several videos and it just sits there on my screen. So I exit and go back in. I see ‘AFK’ gift. Same thing. Tap on it and it never goes anywhere. No gift from either. Just endless videos. 

Whatever you do, don’t tap on them or it basically freezes your game. Endless videos no reward. And there is no way to click away from it.. you just have to exit.
